The single-degree-of-freedom analysis which serves as the basis for the flexural response calculation requires that the equivalent stiffness and ultimate resistance be defined for both single-span beams and continuous beams. The ultimate resistance values correspond to developing a full collapse mechanism in each case. The equivalent stiffnesses correspond to load-deflection relationships that have been idealized as bilinear functions with initial slopes so defined that the areas under the idealized load deflection diagrams are equal to the areas under the actual diagrams at the point of inception of fully plastic behavior of the beam. This concept is covered in Section 3-13 of Chapter 3.
